en: To you, who do not find fault, I will now reveal this most secret knowledge together with its realisation; knowing it, you will be freed from all that is harmful.
speaker: Krishna said

en: This is the king of sciences, the king of secrets, the supreme purifier. It is known directly, it is in keeping with dharma, it is easy to practise, and it is imperishable.
People who have no faith in this dharma, scorcher of foes, do not reach me; they return to the path of death and rebirth.
All this world is pervaded by me in my unmanifest form. All beings rest in me, but I do not rest in them.

sa: न च मत्स्थानि भूतानि पश्य मे योगमैश्वरम्।
tr: na ca matsthāni bhūtāni paśya me yogamaiśvaram
en: And yet beings do not rest in me: behold my divine yoga! Sustaining all beings and bringing them forth, my Self does not dwell in them.
As the mighty wind, moving everywhere, always rests in space, so know that all beings rest in me.
At the end of a cycle, son of Kunti, all beings return to my nature; at the beginning of the next cycle, I send them forth again.
Taking hold of my own nature, I send forth again and again this whole multitude of beings, helpless under the sway of nature.

sa: न च मां तानि कर्माणि निबध्नन्ति धनञ्जय।
tr: na ca māṃ tāni karmāṇi nibadhnanti dhanañjaya
en: These actions do not bind me, Dhananjaya, for I sit as one indifferent, unattached to them.
Under my watch, nature brings forth all that moves and does not move; because of this, son of Kunti, the world turns round and round.
Fools disregard me when I take a human form, not knowing my higher being as the great lord of all beings.
Vain in hope, vain in action, vain in knowledge, without discernment, they take on the deluding nature of fiends and demons.
But great souls, Partha, sheltered in the divine nature, worship me with undistracted minds, knowing me as the imperishable source of all beings.
Always singing my praise, striving with firm vows, bowing to me with devotion, ever disciplined, they worship me.
Others, offering the sacrifice of knowledge, worship me as one, as distinct, and as manifold, facing every direction.
I am the ritual, I am the sacrifice, I am the offering to the ancestors, I am the healing herb; I am the mantra, I am the ghee, I am the fire, and I am the act of offering.

sa: वेद्यं पवित्रमोंकार ऋक् साम यजुरेव च ॥
tr: vedyaṃ pavitramoṃkāra ṛk sāma yajureva ca
en: I am the father of this world, the mother, the sustainer and the grandsire; the one to be known, the purifier, the syllable Om, and the Rig, Sama and Yajur Vedas.

sa: गतिर्भर्ता प्रभुः साक्षी निवासः शरणं सुहृत्।
tr: gatirbhartā prabhuḥ sākṣī nivāsaḥ śaraṇaṃ suhṛt
en: I am the goal, the support, the lord, the witness, the abode, the refuge and the friend; the origin, the dissolution and the ground; the treasure-house and the imperishable seed.
I give heat; I hold back the rain and send it forth. I am immortality and also death, being and non-being, Arjuna.

Those who know the three Vedas, drink the soma and are cleansed of sin worship me with sacrifices and pray for the way to heaven. Reaching the holy world of Indra, they enjoy the divine pleasures of the gods.
Having enjoyed that vast heaven, when their merit is spent they enter the world of mortals again. Following the rituals of the three Vedas and wanting enjoyment, they come and go.
But those who worship me, thinking of nothing else, always united with me: I carry what they lack and protect what they have.
Even those who worship other gods with faith, son of Kunti, worship me alone, though not in the prescribed way.

sa: अहं हि सर्वयज्ञानां भोक्ता च प्रभुरेव च।
tr: ahaṃ hi sarvayajñānāṃ bhoktā ca prabhureva ca
en: For I am the enjoyer and the lord of all sacrifices. But they do not know me as I truly am, and so they fall.

sa: भूतानि यान्ति भूतेज्या यान्ति मद्याजिनोऽपि माम् ॥
tr: bhūtāni yānti bhūtejyā yānti madyājino'pi mām
en: Those devoted to the gods go to the gods; those devoted to the ancestors go to the ancestors; those who worship spirits go to the spirits; and my worshippers come to me.

sa: पत्रं पुष्पं फलं तोयं यो मे भक्त्या प्रयच्छति।
tr: patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ toyaṃ yo me bhaktyā prayacchati
en: Whoever offers me with devotion a leaf, a flower, a fruit or a little water, that offering of love from a pure heart I accept.
Whatever you do, whatever you eat, whatever you offer, whatever you give, whatever austerity you practise, son of Kunti, do it as an offering to me.
So you will be freed from the bonds of action and their good and bad fruits. With your self disciplined by the yoga of renunciation, freed, you will come to me.

sa: समोऽहं सर्वभूतेषु न मे द्वेष्योऽस्ति न प्रियः।
ये भजन्ति तु मां भक्त्या मयि ते तेषु चाप्यहम् ॥
tr: samo'haṃ sarvabhūteṣu na me dveṣyo'sti na priyaḥ
ye bhajanti tu māṃ bhaktyā mayi te teṣu cāpyaham
en: I am the same to all beings; to me none is hateful and none dear. But those who worship me with devotion are in me, and I am in them.

sa: साधुरेव स मन्तव्यः सम्यग्व्यवसितो हि सः ॥
tr: sādhureva sa mantavyaḥ samyagvyavasito hi saḥ
en: Even if a person of very bad conduct worships me with undivided devotion, they should be counted as good, for they have resolved rightly.

sa: कौन्तेय प्रतिजानीहि न मे भक्तः प्रणश्यति ॥
tr: kaunteya pratijānīhi na me bhaktaḥ praṇaśyati
en: Quickly they become righteous and reach lasting peace. Know this for certain, son of Kunti: my devotee never perishes.

sa: मां हि पार्थ व्यपाश्रित्य येऽपि स्युः पापयोनयः।
स्त्रियो वैश्यास्तथा शूद्रास्तेऽपि यान्ति परां गतिम् ॥
tr: māṃ hi pārtha vyapāśritya ye'pi syuḥ pāpayonayaḥ
striyo vaiśyāstathā śūdrāste'pi yānti parāṃ gatim
en: Those who take refuge in me, Partha, whatever their birth, women, merchants and labourers too, reach the highest goal.
How much more, then, the pure brahmins and the devoted royal sages. Having come into this passing, joyless world, worship me.

sa: मन्मना भव मद्भक्तो मद्याजी मां नमस्कुरु।
tr: manmanā bhava madbhakto madyājī māṃ namaskuru
en: Fix your mind on me, be devoted to me, offer to me, bow to me. Uniting yourself with me in this way, making me your goal, you will come to me.
